checks.name: the LLM recommends DENY for the cross-district request, and the advice is committed and verified
the auditor grants over the DENY on the phone, and the phone shows it confirmed and first in its access log
the ledger records FORCE_ALLOW against the LLM (NOT_AGREED), with the digest of the auditor note
that decision created one reusable authorization for exactly this scope
the repeated request on the Mac is granted at once by the authorization
the reused request has no LLM recommendation and no auditor decision on the ledger
the access log shows the reuse as granted by the authorization, with the LLM not asked
after the revocation the same request waits for an auditor again
that request is closed by following the advice
nothing is left waiting and no authorization is left active
